review_kind: ten complete single-file exact-version static candidate decisions; NOT governed verification
package_identity_method: Exact pinned SKILL.md Git blob matched fetch; independent one-entry Git tree SHA1 calculation matched each package tree; 10/10 complete single-file packages.
macro_findings: Two tool-driven QA procedures presume background or immediate test execution, with no scoped authorization for target, side effects, cost, or remote data egress.
Remote ScoutQA procedure explicitly sends application URLs and potentially credentials to a third-party service; the host-specific timeout instructions are not portable.
React 19 StrictMode effect-count claim is not a safe universal migration rule; MSTest 3.x/4.x API examples require version-specific compilation.
Generic SQL review conflates dialects; PostgreSQL review's JSONB index and session-bound RLS examples need correction before reuse.
Oracle migration family has a useful plan/scaffold/test progression but relies on rollback as a safety substitute and omits secure credential and isolated database controls.
No package-owned references/scripts/assets in this tranche; each complete package is one SKILL.md at a verified Git tree. No cross-source semantic duplicate resolution claimed.
